newsitem.title: USA: Judge allows Old Guard to convert to stock company.
newsitem.headline: Judge allows Old Guard to convert to stock company.

text.p: Old Guard Insurance Group said Commonwealth Court Judge Joseph Kelley denied a motion that would block the mutual insurer's conversion to a stock company.
Donald Nikolaus, president of the Donegal Group Inc, sought the preliminary injunction, the company said in a statement issued February 8.
Nikolaus filed the lawsuit in his capacity as an Old Guard policyholder and challenged the 1995 Pennsylvania Insurance Company Mutual-to-Stock Conversion Act, Old Guard said.
Although no opinion has yet been filed, the judge's order does cite a case that makes it clear that the injunction was denied on the merits, Old Guard said.
Denial of the preliminary injunction does not terminate the lawsuit and Nikolaus may still seek a trial on the merits, the company said.
